Bitcoin was trapped for over a month. Oil at $107, inflation fears rising, and nobody wanted to touch risk assets while the Strait of Hormuz sat closed.

Tonight that changed. Ceasefire confirmed. Oil dumped 10% instantly. Bitcoin went from $68K to $72.7K and $600M in shorts got wiped out in hours.

But here’s what most people aren’t talking about — ETF inflows hit $471M on Monday alone. The biggest single day since February. Institutional money wasn’t absent. It was waiting.

Two weeks is not a peace deal though. If talks collapse, $65K gets tested fast. But if the Clarity Act passes late April on top of this ceasefire holding? $75K is right there.

Watch the headlines, not just the price.

Buying Gift Cards using #monero or #bitcoin can add friction. You need to manage these cards, print them, take a screenshot, etc.

For those using an accounting software for budget is also a pain to write down the purchases.

That’s why I spent the evening coming up with a mockup that I will build this week. A self hosted Giftcard vault.

Very easy. Just add the number and nip for each store and you can get the barcode scanned at the cash.

This manager will ease the management and have all the cards in one web app. Everything is stored on your own self hosted instance and there will be a history/statement that can be generated to import in your budgeting app.
